fortran.cipcsl2 sub set_uniform_cell:
!--- point value + profile variables consistent with a uniform concentration in cell nn ---
    module subroutine set_uniform_cell(mf, nn, cval)
        integer(i4), intent(in) :: mf, nn
        real(dp), intent(in) :: cval
        real(dp) :: dxx(0:2)
        dxx = [dx(0, in(nn)), dx(1, jn(nn)), dx(2, kn(nn))]
        c(mf, nn) = cval
        cn(mf, nn) = cval
        associate (m => ade_cipcsl2_mf(mf))
            m%c(nn) = cval; m%cn(nn) = cval                                   ! node values (CIP-private)
            m%sigma_p(:, nn) = cval*dxx                                        ! σx, σy, σz
            m%S_p(:, nn) = cval*[dxx(1)*dxx(2), dxx(2)*dxx(0), dxx(0)*dxx(1)]  ! Syz, Szx, Sxy
            ! rho_p is rebuilt from cmass at the start of the transport
        end associate
    end subroutine set_uniform_cell
